nom: L'Oréal Bright Reveal Dark Spot Exfoliant Peel

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: several say the peel is gentle enough not to irritate even dry, sensitive, aging skin, while others report tingling, burning, or dryness serious enough to recommend against use, and reviewers without sensitive skin specifically warn it may not suit those who have it.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results: one says it improved her dry, tight-feeling cheeks and helped skin retain moisture, while another with dry skin developed dryness and irritation on her cheeks that persisted even after cutting back to once a week.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive combination skin could only tolerate using the peel once a week instead of the recommended four times, and saw only slight fading of her lighter spots after a month, with little change to the darkest ones.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin found the peel gentle, with zero irritation, redness or tingling, but saw no change in her skin tone.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found a spot-tested area left completely clean, as if the product had drawn the oil out.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes her skin as dry, sensitive and aging, and found the peel incredibly gentle yet effective, making her other moisturizing products work better.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the peel left their skin feeling dry or tight, including one whose cheeks stayed irritated even at reduced frequency; others, including one with dry skin, say it actually improved dryness and helped skin retain moisture, with tight, dry mornings disappearing.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer references another buyer's report that her skin barrier was damaged after layering her full routine on top of the peel, and stresses that the instructions explicitly warn against applying any other product immediately afterward.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers, including several with acne scarring, post-acne dark marks, or deep tan-to-brown skin needing extra caution against PIH, report visible fading of dark spots over two to several weeks of consistent use; a meaningful minority saw no change in discoloration even after three or more weeks, and one reviewer's peel helped her acne scars but did nothing for her sun spots specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin say consistent use reduced breakouts or helped clear active acne alongside fading the resulting scars; none report the peel triggering new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the peel leaves treated areas feeling completely clean and free of excess oil, without adding greasiness.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable tingling or stinging on application
Glitter or shimmer can be hard to rinse off
Applicator dispenses product poorly at first
Chemical or medicinal scent bothers some users

extraits.texte: I'll first start off by saying I received this product free of charge in exchange for my honest review. Over a 21+ day usage, I have not noticed the first change in discoloration in the dark spot areas I utilized the product on. Neither did I ever notice the skin "peel" to expose new skin. The product does have a light scent and it smells good. The bottle wasn't made too well; glass bottle with a flimsy rubber tip. This allowed for too much product to be expelled from the bottle all at once.

I tried this out for about a month. Followed the directions and all. I couldn't get over the tacky feeling once I'd applied it and left it to dry down for a bit. After rinsing my face though, after about the first week my skin was softer. BUT my cheeks got so dry! It didn't matter what moisturizer I used my cheeks were irritated. Even when I cut down and used it 1x a week.

extraits.titre: Does work but have to be mindful of what you use it with
extraits.texte: I have sensitive combination skin and suffer from dark spots. It does say to use it 4 times a week but not back to back. Due to my sensitive skin, I could only use once a week. I do see difference in the initial lighter spots that actually looks more faded at the end of month. But the very dark spots have very slight and not so noticeable difference. A month doesn't show big difference overall but if I continue, I will see more of a difference difference in 3 months compared to day one. Heed the warning to be careful what you use in combination with this as not to get a chemical burn. On days I use this, I just kept with basic moisturizer at night. I am giving it a 3 rating as average as I did not see drastic change in the month but I know it is working even if slowly.

I was SO excited to receive this product because it said it'd help even out my skin tone. However, I did not notice any difference in my skin tone hence the rating. I gave this 3 stars because it was gentle on my skin (zero irritation, zero redness, zero tingling). I have normal skin. Other than that, it really didn't do much for my skin.

extraits.auteur: This product worked great. It fades dark
extraits.texte: This product worked great. It fades dark spots and really brightens up the face. The stinging was bearable and eventually was unnoticeable. What I noticed after the second use was that my skin was looking plumper which I think was because the peel was helping my skin retain moisture better. I didn't change anything from my normal routine but I noticed that the I no longer woke up in the mornings with a tight dry face. As someone with dry skin I have to reapply moisturizer occasionally throughout the day but this had improved my dryness. The only thing I didn't like about this product was the sparkle stuff in it. It doesn't wash out with just water and so I felt as if I wasn't washing the peel completely off. I would've had to scrubbed my skin if I wanted it completely off so I just let it be. You probably wouldn't even notice the glitter but once I did I couldn't ignore it.

Years ago I loved a peel that Neutrogena had - they discontinued it and I had never found anything with similar results until now. I have dry, sensitive, aging skin and this product is incredibly gentle, yet effective. My skin looks much clearer, brighter and it makes my moisturizing products so much more effective. I'm buying a backup bottle now - please don't ever discontinue this. PS - It does smell bad when you put it on, but it is short lived, and completely worth it.
I got this for christmas and have really oily skin, after I spot tested it on my cheeks, it left that spot soooo clean! Like it sucked the oil out!
